app.name: Temu Kembali

app.description: Find lost items, pets, vehicles, or help reunite with people you're looking for

hero.title: Temu Kembali
hero.subtitle: Digital Community Platform for Connecting Lost and Found
hero.description: Find lost items, pets, vehicles, or help reunite with people you're looking for

categories.title: How Can We Help?
categories.subtitle: Choose a category that suits your needs
categories.items_desc: Wallets, phones, keys, documents, and other items
categories.pets_desc: Cats, dogs, birds, and beloved animals
categories.missing_persons_desc: Search for missing persons and reunions

features.title: Why Temu Kembali?
features.subtitle: Features that help you find what you're looking for
features.location_search_desc: Find reports around you with accurate location filters
features.smart_matching_desc: Automatic system matches lost reports with found items
features.secure_communication_desc: Encrypted in-app chat to protect your privacy
features.caring_community_desc: Join thousands of people helping each other
features.reputation_system_desc: Trusted users get badges and reputation points
features.advanced_search_desc: Filter by category, time, and specific characteristics

cta.title: Ready to Help or Get Help?
cta.subtitle: Join the Temu Kembali community and let's help each other find what's lost

explore.title: Explore Reports
explore.subtitle: Find or help others find what's lost

create.title: Create Report
create.subtitle: Report a loss or finding to help others

report_type.title: Report Type
report_type.subtitle: Choose the type of report you want to create

basic_info.title: Basic Information
basic_info.report_title_placeholder: Example: Lost Brown Leather Wallet at Mall
basic_info.description_hint: Use complete language and avoid abbreviations to help the automatic matching system work more accurately

person_details.title: Person Details
person_details.subtitle_find: Information about the person you want to reconnect with (reunion)
person_details.physical_features_placeholder: Example: Short black hair, brown eyes, mole on right cheek...
person_details.last_wearing_placeholder: Example: White t-shirt, blue jeans, black shoes...
person_details.relationship_placeholder: Example: Elementary school friend, distant relative, old neighbor...
person_details.last_known_info_placeholder: Example: Last lived in Jakarta in 2010, worked as a teacher...

reward.title: Reward (Optional)
reward.checkbox: I want to offer a reward for the finder

verification.title: Identity Verification
verification.subtitle: For mutual security, we require verification of your phone number and ID card before making a claim
verification.security_notice: Your data will be encrypted and only used for verification. We protect your privacy.
verification.upload_prompt: Click to upload ID card photo
verification.chat_notice: After the claim is accepted, you will be able to communicate with the reporter via in-app chat
verification.required_notice: By claiming, you agree to verify your identity

safety.title: Safety Tips
safety.tip2: Don't share personal information outside the app
